sentences.en: We only have a little money.
sentences.notes: nur wenig = 'only a little', still stressing how little.

sentences.text: Ich weiß nur wenig über ihn.
sentences.en: I know only a little about him.

sentences.text: Ich habe zu wenig Geld dabei.
sentences.en: I don't have enough money on me.

sentences.text: Wir müssen noch ein wenig warten.
sentences.en: We have to wait a little longer.

sentences.text: Kannst du mir ein wenig helfen?
sentences.en: Can you help me a little?

meanings.notes: REVIEW warning: This meaning is tagged ADV, but most of its sentences (ein wenig Englisch, ein wenig Angst) use ein wenig before a noun as a quantifier, not as an adverb; the ADV meaning of wenig has the mirror-image problem. Consider splitting ein wenig as quantifier (+ noun) vs. adverb (ein wenig warten / schwer), as is done for bisschen.
